principles.statement: The Omnoid is the larger cosmological frame.
Source, aspect, manifestation and incarnation are distinct identity categories.
Agency, harm, responsibility and repair govern the ethical inquiry.
Multiple clocks coexist; consequences last across return and remembering.
Novels and the complete parallel Codex share adopted events.
Re-cohering retrieves or integrates a prior state without deleting what others experienced.
Power, antiquity, knowledge and radiance do not confer moral authority.
A shared name, symbol, function or memory cannot by itself prove shared identity.
Story ordering and testimony are distinct from external historical dating.

sources.scope: Omnoid, five-layer expression, continuity and forward-only consequences
Cross-section, travel and re-cohering vocabulary; formal claims need reconciliation

entities.name: Omnoid
entities.description: The encompassing cosmological frame; not an actor merely because it contains actors.

entities.name: The Mother
entities.description: Primordial receptive depth in the Codex; distinguish from every daughter or local title.

entities.name: First Flame
entities.description: Lonely creative consciousness in the existing drafts; Father-aspect is not the whole source.

entities.name: The Father
entities.description: A relational creative aspect; a command attributed to Father still requires speaker and witness.

entities.name: Lilith
entities.description: A distinct sovereign identity expressing refusal and equality; Mother-aspect resemblance does not erase her biography.

entities.name: Adam
entities.description: Naming, blame and the difficult practice of repair; no forgiveness is owed automatically.

entities.name: Eve
entities.description: Knowledge and choice under inherited coercion; two substantial draft versions remain preserved.

entities.name: Sophia / the Knowing Child
entities.description: The Codex gives this figure the serpent and awakening roles; comparative traditions remain independently sourced.

entities.name: The Garden Serpent
entities.description: A narrative manifestation linked to Sophia in one draft; not a universal identity claim.

entities.name: Lucifer / Lightbringer
entities.description: Illumination and dissent; Firstborn provenance does not make Light identical to First Flame.

entities.name: Cain
entities.description: Fratricide, protection and displacement; violence survives the perpetrator’s explanation.

entities.name: Abel
entities.description: A person with a life before becoming evidence in another person’s moral argument.

entities.name: Enoch
entities.description: Journeying witness whose experience and transmitted books are different clocks.

entities.name: Noah
entities.description: Survival, covenant and the unequal aftermath of catastrophe.

entities.name: Abraham
entities.description: A covenant household leader whose hospitality and coercive decisions both have consequences.

entities.name: Sarah
entities.description: Covenant participant with desires and power beyond an heir-producing function.

entities.name: Hagar
entities.description: Expulsion and survival seen from the person made expendable by a household.

entities.name: Ishmael
entities.description: A lineage-bearing person; do not reduce him to a comparative-religion connector.

entities.name: Isaac
entities.description: Inheritance shaped by the remembered threat of sacrifice.

entities.name: Jacob / Israel
entities.description: Naming, rivalry, exile and changed obligations.

entities.name: Joseph
entities.description: Trafficking survivor who later controls grain, access and dependence.

entities.name: Moses
entities.description: Liberator and lawgiver; claims to authority remain accountable to the governed.

entities.name: Miriam
entities.description: Leadership, song, challenge and communal memory.

entities.name: Aaron
entities.description: Ritual leadership operating under divided pressures.

entities.name: Joshua
entities.description: Conquest testimony must retain the lives and claims of inhabitants.

entities.name: Ruth
entities.description: Migration, labour, kinship and consent within material insecurity.

entities.name: Samuel
entities.description: Prophetic authority and the demand for a king.

entities.name: Saul
entities.description: Kingship’s insecurity and the machinery of belonging.

entities.name: David
entities.description: A ruler whose poetry and charisma do not cancel exploitation.

entities.name: Bathsheba
entities.description: Political and personal survival; retain perspective beyond royal desire.

entities.name: Solomon
entities.description: Wisdom and centralization; distinguish this lineage from V2 Threshold-dweller Solomon.

entities.name: Esther
entities.description: Diaspora survival amid royal violence; narrative setting is not a secure event date.

entities.name: Judith
entities.description: Resistance narrative with deliberate historical tensions; no false imperial harmonization.

entities.name: Tobit
entities.description: Diaspora, care, burial and restored relationships; narrated era differs from transmission.

entities.name: Jesus
entities.description: Incarnational identity is central to the selected narrative; preserve distinct testimony before choosing fictional synthesis.

entities.name: Mary, mother of Jesus
entities.description: Embodied family and witness; no automatic identity with the primordial Mother.

entities.name: Mary Magdalene
entities.description: A witness with agency; distinguish named women and avoid conflated biographies.

entities.name: Peter
entities.description: Devotion, failure and competing claims of leadership.

entities.name: Paul
entities.description: Letters address situated communities; do not turn all disputed reception into a single speaker.

entities.name: John of Patmos
entities.description: The visionary named in Revelation; do not automatically equate with every Johannine author.

entities.name: Lily / Lilith Vance
entities.description: Modern Unraveling identity; remembering cannot erase her present relationships or replace her consent.

entities.name: June Park
entities.description: Probability-sensitive ally whose loyalty must remain a choice.

entities.name: Yuna
entities.description: A child witness; exceptional perception does not justify adults instrumentalizing her.

entities.name: The Architect
entities.description: Former Keeper in the original; Eve in V2. Role and occupant are separately indexed.

entities.name: Solomon of the Threshold
entities.description: V2 toll-keeper; no confirmed equivalence to the ancient king.

entities.name: The Hollow
entities.description: Drafts alternate entropy, loneliness and wounded relation; avoid diagnosing actual people through this metaphor.

entities.name: Cael Morrow
entities.description: Sevenfold Theft protagonist; shared cosmological imagery does not yet establish shared continuity.

entities.name: Veraine Solace
entities.description: Sevenfold Theft fracture-seer; retain distinct powers until a crossover is adopted.

identity_relations.note: The Father is a relational expression, not the totality of the source.
Lilith’s biography and consent remain her own.
Supported by one Codex literary strand, not a historical equivalence.
A retrieved memory must be corroborated before merging identities.
V2 proposal conflicts with the original former-Keeper history.
A maternal title supplies no identity proof.
Lightbringer is not simply another name for First Flame.

realms.name: Omnoid
realms.description: A containing relation, not an extra numbered biome.
realms.clock_rule: Unknown; no global clock has been established.
realms.failure_or_cost: No map can make every history simultaneously readable.

realms.name: Earth / historical world
realms.description: The biblical and historical spine, with geographic and cultural specificity.
realms.clock_rule: Historical dating when supported; otherwise relative story order.
realms.failure_or_cost: Distance, institutions, bodies and material scarcity matter.

realms.name: Fundament
realms.description: Baseline embodied experience in the Unraveling vocabulary.
realms.failure_or_cost: Ordinary vulnerability persists even when other realms are perceived.

realms.name: Threshold
realms.description: Traversable liminality; places become accessible under stated local conditions.
realms.clock_rule: Rate and transit duration must be set scene by scene.
realms.failure_or_cost: Disorientation, missed appointments and incompatible passage terms.

realms.name: Labyrinth
realms.description: Paths and alternatives may be encountered without deleting enacted history.
realms.clock_rule: Sequence is known only along a traveller’s own route.
realms.failure_or_cost: Confusing a possible self with the person who owes a present obligation.

realms.name: Reflection
realms.description: Encounter with contested self-image and other witnesses.
realms.clock_rule: No universal conversion to Earth time.
realms.failure_or_cost: Insight may be partial; reflected agreement is not consent.

realms.name: Engine
realms.clock_rule: Causal processes need declared before/after ordering.
realms.failure_or_cost: Intervention has system-wide costs; explanatory access is not unlimited power.

realms.name: Web
realms.description: Connections and their histories made navigable.
realms.clock_rule: Concurrent contacts may have different experienced durations.
realms.failure_or_cost: Connection can burden, expose or betray; participation is revocable.

realms.name: Sight
realms.clock_rule: Observation order differs from event order.
realms.failure_or_cost: Seeing one view does not settle all testimony.

realms.name: Crown
realms.description: A high-order meeting with the limits of an individual perspective.
realms.failure_or_cost: Scale can obscure individual suffering; no moral rank is granted.

realms.name: Eden
realms.description: The Garden of the selected narrative; its Earth coordinates are unestablished.
realms.failure_or_cost: Leaving changes relationships and conditions; no easy return erases exile.

realms.name: Lost domains
realms.description: Four missing domains in older drafts; loss, hiddenness and inaccessibility are distinct possibilities.
realms.failure_or_cost: Do not import recovered realms without accounting for inhabitants and elapsed time.

realms.name: Gyre / Eight Reaches
realms.description: Sevenfold Theft topology, provisionally held beside the biblical series.
realms.clock_rule: Its chronology is uncorrelated with Earth.
realms.failure_or_cost: No crossover is established solely by a torus, a Threshold or seven Thrones.

realms.name: Wolfspace pockets
realms.description: Folded-access motif in the Sevenfold companion paper.
realms.clock_rule: Unknown; its equations do not supply a validated conversion.
realms.failure_or_cost: Pocket accessibility and costs require a future adopted rule.

halo.distribution: Unestablished in fiction. Independent fair eight-sided dice is a mathematical test model only.
no_inference: A three-die roll is not a moral verdict.
An unexpected outcome does not establish an observer’s consent.

factions.name: Firstborn assemblies
factions.survival_function: Keep creation intelligible and preserve senior status.
factions.internal_tension: Care for younger beings competes with entitlement.

factions.name: Archonic administrations
factions.survival_function: Maintain a chosen order even when it requires denial.
factions.power_or_extraction: Permission, naming, confinement and selective testimony.
factions.internal_tension: Officers know different portions of the harm they enable.

factions.name: Watchers
factions.survival_function: Observe and sometimes cross the boundary into participation.
factions.internal_tension: Detachment can conceal responsibility rather than avoid it.

factions.name: Covenant households
factions.power_or_extraction: Kinship, labour, food and marriage arrangements.
factions.internal_tension: Household belonging can protect one person while expelling another.

factions.name: Egyptian imperial institutions
factions.survival_function: Maintain labour, supply and royal order.
factions.internal_tension: Ordinary workers, officials and rulers must not become one moral silhouette.

factions.name: Wilderness assembly
factions.survival_function: Keep a displaced community alive and negotiate authority.
factions.power_or_extraction: Food allocation, law, worship and collective sanction.
factions.internal_tension: Survival does not eliminate dissent or legitimate coercion.

factions.name: Royal houses
factions.power_or_extraction: Taxation, courts, armies and sacred patronage.
factions.internal_tension: Subjects benefit unevenly; internal rivals retain their own reasons.

factions.name: Prophetic witnesses
factions.survival_function: Contest abuses and communicate situated visions.
factions.internal_tension: Sincerity is not omniscience; different witnesses can conflict.

factions.name: Assyrian, Babylonian and Persian administrations
factions.survival_function: Different states with different aims; never a single unchanged empire.
factions.power_or_extraction: Deportation, tribute, rebuilding, appointments and archives.
factions.internal_tension: Administrative continuity can coexist with changed rulers and changed policy.

factions.name: Diaspora communities
factions.survival_function: Preserve life and belonging across changed places.
factions.power_or_extraction: Language, care, trade, story and local alliances.
factions.internal_tension: Preservation and adaptation create real internal disagreement.

factions.name: Resistance networks
factions.internal_tension: Victory can reproduce the extraction it opposed.

factions.name: Jesus movement
factions.survival_function: Teach, heal, share, argue and bear witness under empire.
factions.power_or_extraction: Meals, journeys, words and personal commitment.
factions.internal_tension: Followers disagree about risk, meaning and leadership.

factions.name: Early assemblies
factions.survival_function: Build communities from divergent histories and expectations.
factions.power_or_extraction: Letters, hospitality, funds and competing authority claims.
factions.internal_tension: A letter’s remedy can become later domination when stripped of circumstance.

factions.name: Copyists and custodians
factions.survival_function: Carry texts through vulnerable material and political conditions.
factions.power_or_extraction: Selection, copying, translation, preservation and loss.
factions.internal_tension: Transmission can be care, error, adaptation or control; establish evidence per case.

factions.name: Concordat
factions.internal_tension: Preparedness is not permission to direct another life.

factions.name: Coalition
factions.survival_function: Coordinate defence and repair across independent groups.
factions.power_or_extraction: Shared knowledge, commitments and local competence.
factions.internal_tension: Cooperation can fail without making every dissenter a villain.

factions.name: Seven Thrones
factions.survival_function: Maintain their positions within the Gyre candidate continuity.
factions.power_or_extraction: Interception of quintessence in Sevenfold Theft.
factions.internal_tension: Imported villain logic must not automatically redefine every biblical deity.

capabilities.name: Cross-section travel
capabilities.capability: Move a consenting traveller into another locally lawful expression.
capabilities.conditions: A compatible destination, an adopted route and an elapsed-time contract.
capabilities.costs: Energy, delay, exposure and interruption of obligations.
capabilities.failure_modes: Failed compatibility can leave the traveller unable to embody.
capabilities.ethical_limit: Access is not permission; nobody else’s biography is reset.

capabilities.name: Reincarnation / resurrection
capabilities.capability: A continuity may acquire renewed local expression.
capabilities.conditions: Continuity evidence and a receiving substrate; exact mechanism unestablished.
capabilities.costs: Lost time, changed relationships, care and uncertain recall.
capabilities.failure_modes: Mistaken identity, incomplete recall or inability to return.
capabilities.ethical_limit: No guaranteed return and no cancellation of another person’s death.

capabilities.name: Re-cohering
capabilities.capability: Integrate a prior capability or memory into the present.
capabilities.conditions: A specific recoverable state and consent to the encounter.
capabilities.costs: Fatigue, reinterpretation and conflict with present commitments.
capabilities.ethical_limit: Retrieval is not retroactive consent or rewriting.

capabilities.name: HALO practice
capabilities.capability: Use FLOW, MIRROR and GATE as a bounded choice grammar.
capabilities.conditions: Three distinguished dice / domains; actual magical mechanics pending.
capabilities.costs: Attention, commitment, risk and consequences of interpretation.
capabilities.failure_modes: Misreading, bias or a mismatch between intent and action.
capabilities.ethical_limit: A roll does not override agency or prove metaphysical truth.

capabilities.name: Extended perception
capabilities.capability: Encounter information unavailable to an ordinary local perspective.
capabilities.conditions: A declared perceptual scope and a named witness.
capabilities.failure_modes: Confusing probability, reflection or testimony with fact.
capabilities.ethical_limit: Perception cannot supply consent on another’s behalf.

capabilities.name: Naming
capabilities.capability: Address, distinguish or coordinate with a particular identity.
capabilities.conditions: Enough context to distinguish source, role and incarnation.
capabilities.costs: Exposure and responsibility for a claim made publicly.
capabilities.failure_modes: Misidentification, coercive naming or inherited slurs.
capabilities.ethical_limit: A name is neither a deed of ownership nor a universal control word.

capabilities.name: Repair
capabilities.capability: Change damaged conditions through material action and accountability.
capabilities.conditions: The harmed party’s needs and retained right to refuse reconciliation.
capabilities.costs: Labour, resources, restitution and lost privilege.
capabilities.failure_modes: Performative apology, recidivism or an offered remedy that deepens harm.
capabilities.ethical_limit: The perpetrator cannot declare the victim healed.

capabilities.name: Shared power
capabilities.capability: Coordinate separate agents without collapsing their identities.
capabilities.conditions: Revocable agreements, visible costs and realistic shared capacity.
capabilities.costs: Time, conflicting priorities and responsibility for dependent others.
capabilities.failure_modes: Capture by a leader, silent exclusion or broken commitments.
capabilities.ethical_limit: Dissent is not proof of corruption.

glossary.definition: The approved larger cosmological frame. The diagram shows conceptual relations, not a scientific model.
A locally experienced world or moment within the larger frame; its exact geometry is not yet adopted.
The ordered sequence a being or community lives through. A later return does not delete earlier experience.
An originating identity or principle. A source is not interchangeable with every expression attributed to it.
A particular relational or functional expression of a source, indexed separately from the whole.
A local appearance or acting presence. Its claimed source may be accurate, mistaken or deceptive.
An embodied life with its own biography and agency, even when continuity with another life is established.
A proposition about who someone is. Names, resemblance and memories are evidence to examine, not automatic proof.
What persists across changes of embodiment. The project has not adopted a universal test for proving it.
The outward expression of spirit in the Omnoid source vocabulary; not a diagnostic claim about real people.
The inward continuity vocabulary of the cosmology; its status here is literary/metaphysical, not measured physical substance.
The Omnoid source’s term for local form and the conversion between intention and expression; not necessarily metal machinery.
The vulnerable embodied surface. Cosmic significance does not prevent bodily pain, hunger or exhaustion.
The structural layer of embodiment in the inherited vocabulary; not an exact anatomical system for every realm.
The proposed passage where inward and outward expression meet. It is not a route through another’s consent.
The local conditions in which a being can take form; different settings may require different lawful expression.
The inherited term for forming a local expression again. Its available mechanisms and costs remain proposals.
Recovering or integrating something into the present without erasing the intervening history.
An inherited phrase requiring care: this project interprets it as present integration, not the power to overwrite another life.
A traversable or experienceable domain. It is not automatically a gate function or a stage of personal growth.
Baseline embodied reality in the Unraveling vocabulary; the relationship to historical Earth is a candidate mapping.
Liminal geography. The similarly named gate function is a different indexed category.
The domain of choices and alternatives in V2; encountering alternatives does not erase the enacted path.
The realm of contested self-perception; also a separately indexed gate function and a common word.
The V2 domain of local reality’s mechanisms. It is not the whole Omnoid or every being’s Machine layer.
Navigable relations. Connected people remain separate agents with different obligations.
A realm and a capacity concerned with perception. Neither guarantees truth or sound judgment.
A realm and a V2 cultivation label. Their shared name does not establish identical meaning.
One of the Codex’s twelve operative names: a function that may occur in multiple places.
A domain reported missing in an older draft. Destroyed, inaccessible and hidden are different states.
Hidden Axis Labyrinthine Oracle: a three-domain symbolic system inherited from existing drafts.
HALO’s movement domain, containing eight named faces.
HALO’s reflection domain, containing eight named faces; not the same entity as the Reflection realm.
HALO’s choice and boundary domain, containing eight named faces; distinct from twelve gate functions.
One named face. There are twenty-four across the three distinguished dice.
One FLOW result, one MIRROR result and one GATE result in that domain order: 8 × 8 × 8 = 512 possibilities.
A vocabulary of acquired capacities and obligations. Existing ladders are preserved without declaring stage-by-stage equivalence.
A primordial source candidate in the Codex. Lilith, Mary and every mother are not automatically the same person.
A creative consciousness in existing drafts. A lightbearing descendant is not identical merely because both involve light.
Divine children in the inherited mythology; seniority does not grant ownership of later beings.
An authority figure or administration in the selected literary cosmology; historical traditions using this term require separate notes.
A grouping whose observation and involvement vary by source; 1 Enoch must not be silently merged with every angel tradition.
An unresolved draft concept spanning entropy, loneliness and damaged relation. Do not equate mental illness with moral corruption.
A role with competing occupant histories in Unraveling. Eve’s identification is a V2 proposal, not settled series canon.
The Five-Aspect soul-matter vocabulary of Sevenfold Theft; a neighbouring candidate system, not silently imported physics.
The Sevenfold candidate’s cyclical world structure. Similarity to Omnoid imagery is insufficient to prove a shared setting.
Pocket-dimension vocabulary from the in-world academic paper. Its equations are not treated as established mathematics or science.
A being’s capacity and standing to choose, refuse and act. Characters can violate it; the story records the consequences.
Specific, informed, revocable agreement. Silence, identity continuity or another version’s agreement is not a substitute.
Damage to a person or community, including coerced loss of agency; good intentions do not erase effects.
Answerability for choices and their effects, including the work required after unintended harm.
Material and relational work shaped by those harmed. It is different from demanding forgiveness.
A possible choice belonging to the harmed party. It cannot be charged as the price of restitution.
The sequence in a particular text or the proposed braided outline; it does not itself establish historical dates.
An independently supported period or range. Unknown remains unknown, rather than being back-calculated from symbolic ages.
When a text or layer was written. Daniel’s narrated exile setting does not date the composition automatically.
The clock adopted inside a domain, with no conversion until a relation is explicitly established.
A character’s experienced duration, including intervals different from an outside observer’s calendar.
The earliest proposed reader access to a fact. It is spoiler management, not the date of the underlying event.
A changed condition carried into later scenes: a death, debt, disability, migration, promise, destroyed home or broken trust.
